ENGLISH ONLY - no Hindi anywhere (slides or caption). Handwritten notebook-page style, 5 pages per post. Every post must be a RANDOM MIX of page types, never the same structure every time: phrasal verbs, idioms, and 'X vs Y' confusing-word/grammar comparisons (e.g. May vs Might, Say vs Tell, Since vs For). Do not repeat any title already used (see used_sentences.json entries for this channel). Word/idiom pages: {title, meaning, synonym, examples[2], tip[1-2]}. Comparison pages: {type:'compare', title:'A vs B', intro, left:{label, examples[2], note}, right:{label, examples[2], note}, tip[1-2]}. In tip lines '->' draws an arrow. Keep meanings short (under ~12 words), examples under ~8 words, comparison-column examples under ~5 words. Examples must be natural, correct English. See posts/phrasalidiomatic/sample-mix/content.json for the exact JSON.
